Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5 and Qwen3.8-Max stopped after 20 above the two-second median cutoff; partial results are outside this figure.
New LLM/local inputs share the PNG variant; earlier hosted rows keep original PNG/JPEG bytes. Dates, routes and hardware differ.
Purple locals use the deliberately chosen older RTX 2060 6 GB; hardware/electricity unmeasured. † Free access is not a production tariff; ~ tariff calculation; * missing charges.
